guide.title: Usage Guide
guide.feedbackDesc: PomArc evolves with our users. Feel free to send us bug reports or feature requests via 'Feedback' at the top right of the Home screen.
guide.createTaskDesc: Create from the '+' button. Line 1 is the title, line 2+ are notes. Apply Routine or SRS settings to automate your learning schedule.
guide.timerDesc: Features Pomodoro, Countdown, and Stopwatch modes. Study records are automatically saved and reflected in analytics upon completion.
guide.calendarDesc: Check dates on Calendar, time on Schedule. Long-press the schedule to create tasks directly, or scroll seamlessly to view past/future.
guide.srsDesc: Automated review management. Apply SRS profiles to tasks, and optimal review dates based on the forgetting curve will be auto-scheduled.
guide.categoryDesc: Organize with Large/Medium/Small categories. Customizable in settings, and you can check learning ratios by category in Analytics.
guide.routineDesc: Bulk create tasks for specific weekdays. Select days from the calendar icon when creating a Todo to generate tasks for the next 30 days.
guide.historyDesc: View progress graphs in 'Activity'. Grouped history allows you to track SRS and Routine progress at a glance.
guide.shareDesc: Share your achievements on social media. Sharing grants you a 24-hour Ad-Free reward.
guide.syncDesc: Login to sync data in real-time between PC and Mobile. Resume exactly where you left off on any device.
guide.themeDesc: Full Light/Dark mode support. Select 'System' to match your OS settings for your preferred environment.
